scope: lapis next-prompt (Tab) guesses through an ordered OpenAI-compatible provider chain: a private Infinity vLLM endpoint first, OpenRouter second. Model quality and helper behavior only; no desktop GUI, attention-protocol, long-run or 32-session load qualification. omp agent tabs use omp's own retry.fallbackChains and are covered separately in the checks.

source.head: b0d0d38598e79dc62fc408316f646ecb74707691
source.dirty_note: provider chain, docs, tests and the operator's lapis.json

tools.baseline: claude-opus-5-5 through Claude Code print mode on a remote Mac

method.tab_guesses: 30 prompts sampled from the operator's local interactive Claude Code and Codex transcripts since 2026-09-15 (seed 23). Both routes saw the same bundle, system prompt and parse from apps/desktop/src/next_prompt.py. Each produced up to three candidates; all six per prompt were graded in one blind Opus call. Top-1 sendable means the shown guess scored 2.
method.provider_fallback: The primary URL was replaced with http://127.0.0.1:9/v1 and the live OpenRouter entry was kept. The helper returned the OpenRouter answer and its model.
method.omp_fallback: A temporary dead provider used the same model id; omp logged retry_fallback_succeeded with openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017:high. The real infinity provider was then pointed at the dead URL and the same fallback fired with the :high model selector. The original models.yml was restored.
method.checks: python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_next_prompt (43 tests), ctest -R '^next-prompt$' three times, and python3 scripts/lapis.py quality.

configuration.live: nextPrompt.experiment=0; providers[0] is the private Infinity endpoint (apiKeyEnv DEEPSEEK_4X_KEY, 20 s); providers[1] is OpenRouter (apiKeyEnv OPENROUTER_API_KEY, 30 s).
configuration.keys: Read from the process environment, then ~/.env_vars. The key values are not stored in lapis.json and are not in this receipt.
configuration.omp: ~/.omp/agent/config.yml maps the Infinity model to openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 under retry.fallbackChains.

limitations: One 30-prompt sample; the paired difference is one sendable top guess, so the quality comparison is weak evidence of equivalence, not a non-inferiority test.
The OpenRouter fallback answered with a capitalized style in the spot check while the primary stayed lowercase; style on the fallback was not measured over a sample.
The installed /Applications lapis.app predates this change and does not pass --providers; the built app and helper values above are the measured ones.
omp's fallback was exercised with a dead provider and the real provider temporarily pointed at a dead URL; it was not exercised by taking the real Infinity host down.
No GUI Tab interaction was exercised; the helper, its tests and the app build are the evidence.
